name: What factors can cause delays in the real estate closing process?

mainEntity.name: What factors can cause delays in the real estate closing process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several factors can cause delays, including issues with financing such as delayed loan approval or appraisal problems, unforeseen repairs identified during inspection, title defects requiring resolution, or delays in receiving necessary documentation from third parties. Even minor discrepancies in paperwork can halt the process. Proactive management by your closing coordinator is crucial to identify and address these issues early. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution works to mitigate these delays by maintaining constant communication and diligent oversight.
acceptedAnswer.description: Delays can stem from financing issues, inspection repairs, title defects, or documentation problems. Proactive coordination helps mitigate these factors.
